```{r setup, include = FALSE}
### Paths ######################################################################

### Load myFUNCTIONS ###########################################################
source('C:/Users/mkotrova/Work-SYNC/R_scripts/2024-04-12_myFUNCTIONS.R')

### New FUNCTIONS ##############################################################

### Load data ##################################################################
setwd(inputVer)

file_tabVer <- "Tabelle komprimiert - besprochen am 17062025_redundante markiert_orange-red_gelöscht.xlsx"

tabVer <- read_excel(file_tabVer, sheet = "MFI+DNA Blasten sw alt") |>
  janitor::clean_names()  # Cleans and makes column names unique and syntactically valid


```

> **Info:**  
> - Scales normalized column-wise

```{r patients-list, include = FALSE}

patients <- tabVer |>
  select(lebensnummer, dna_nr, subgruppe) |>
  filter(subgruppe == "UBTF-ATXN7L3" | subgruppe == "UBTF-AXTN7L3"| subgruppe == "KMT2A"| subgruppe == "ZNF384" | subgruppe == "DUX4" | subgruppe == "PAX5-plus"| subgruppe == "PAX5 P80R"| subgruppe == "PAX5alt") |>
  select(-subgruppe) |>
  distinct()

```

```{r flow_d0_data, include = FALSE}
tabVer_d0 <- tabVer |>
  dplyr::semi_join(patients, by = "lebensnummer") |> # only keeps rows with lebensnummer values present in patients$lebensnummer
  filter(zeitp_csv == "d0") |>
  group_by(lebensnummer) |>
  arrange(desc(mat == "Knochenmark")) |> # This treats "Knochenmark" as TRUE (1) and others as FALSE (0), sorting rows so "Knochenmark" comes first
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select( -f_nr, -zeitp_csv, -dna_nr, -dna_mat, -sw, -immunphaenotyp, -coo, -age
  )



```

```{r flow_d6_data, include = FALSE}
tabVer_d6 <- tabVer |>
  dplyr::semi_join(patients, by = "lebensnummer") |> # only keeps rows with lebensnummer values present in patients$lebensnummer
  filter(zeitp_csv == "d6") |>
  select( -f_nr, -zeitp_csv, -dna_nr, -dna_mat, -sw, -immunphaenotyp, -coo, -age
  )


```

# d0 expressions by Subgroup {.tabset}

## pro-B

```{r flow_d0_clustered_pro, echo = FALSE}
# Prepare expression matrix and annotation in one clean flow
# Step 1: Build data frame with expression and annotation info
heatmap_data <- tabVer_d0 |>
  select(-lastname) |>
  filter(subgruppe == "UBTF-ATXN7L3" | subgruppe == "UBTF-AXTN7L3"| subgruppe == "KMT2A"| subgruppe == "ZNF384") |>
  arrange(subgruppe)

# Step 3: Extract matrix of CD markers
expr_matrix <- heatmap_data |>
  select(-mat, -lebensnummer, -subgruppe) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) |>
  as.matrix()

# Rename columns
colnames(expr_matrix) <- sub("^blasts_median_", "", colnames(expr_matrix))

# Step 4: Set row names (patient identifiers)
rownames(expr_matrix) <- heatmap_data$lebensnummer


# Step 5: Prepare annotation data
annotation_df <- heatmap_data |>
  select(mat, subgruppe) |>
  as.data.frame()
rownames(annotation_df) <- heatmap_data$lebensnummer


# Step 7: Create the heatmap
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mat = expr_matrix,
  annotation_row = annotation_df,
  scale = "column",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(100),
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 4,
  fontsize_col = 6,
  angle_col = 90
)
```
